verdict.rationale: Bland is a SaaS voice AI platform that processes customer call data, so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a training opt-out, a no-training policy, or a data-usage control. The dedicated isolated enterprise infrastructure is a related but different capability and earns no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
